project.description: Runs after a successful Fetch-Pubs-From-Pubmed_d. Re-fetches from PubMed the publications of the last 3 months (24 months on the 3rd of each month, as a longer sweep) that still have an empty volume or pages, or whose pages are an Elsevier PII placeholder (e.g. Epub-ahead-of-print pubs loaded before the issue was assigned, or article-number papers) and fills them in via fetchPubsFromPubMed.groovy -DfetchMode=update. Never overwrites a populated value with a blank. Pubs for which PubMed has no pagination at all are re-checked each run until they age out of the window.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MONTHS
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Number of months to go back. Leave blank for the default (3, or 24 on the 3rd of the month). Run once with 240 after ZFIN-10241 is deployed.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: UpdateAuthors
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Update Authors? Also overwrite the authors of the selected publications with PubMed's current authors. Leave unchecked for the daily run.
